name: SiteMapExplorer
tagline: Site Map Explorer shows a list of places - stores, customer sites, job addresses, assets or offices - on a map and a list side by side.
description: Site Map Explorer shows a list of places - stores, customer sites, job addresses, assets or offices - on a map and a list side by side. Each place appears as a coloured pin. You can search, filter by type and status, see how far each place is from your depot or from where you are, and open a details card with the address, contact, notes, directions and a link to the record.
features: Pins coloured by category or status, clustering
Category chips with counts, status filter
Distance and radius from a base point or the user's location
Details card with Open record and Directions
Phone Map / List tabs and selection outputs
Works offline without any API key
